name: Psee Demo
description: Solve physics puzzles and help a mystical creature escape in world of Psee.
long_description:
In the mystical world of Psee, gravity rules everything.
Psets creatures can control objects in their world and move using levitation.
You have to control a pset that works in a mine extracting water.
Somewhere evil come to the world of Psee and the main character now needs to save his life.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
